pages: The ash here is warm. It has been warm for a very long time.
Ash remembers what it was. When I touch it, I see shapes. Desks. Glass. A long hall full of instruments, all humming the same note.
Under the cinders, a notebook. The pages burned, but the cover did not. On it, in my handwriting:
I do not remember writing it. My hand does. It is shaking.
